body.name: Exact late-ramp pair
body.construction: At \(c=a_0=1/2\) and \(\delta_0=1/4\), for \(\sigma\in\{-1,1\}\) set \(\bar q^{\sigma}(u)=c\), \(r^{\sigma}(u)=\sigma\delta_0(u-a_0)_+/(1-a_0)\), \(e_{nt}=c/t\), \(m_{nt}(a)=0\), \(Y_{nt}(0)=0\), and \(Y_{nt}^{\sigma}(1)=r^{\sigma}(t/n)\); take \(M\ge\delta_0\), \(\rho\ge c\), \(K\ge c\), and \(L_r\ge\delta_0/(1-a_0)\), and let the complete observation be \(O_n\).
